claims: Response to Intervention (RTI) is a multi-tier educational framework used to identify and support students struggling with learning or behavior through early intervention and data-driven instruction.
RTI provides increasingly intense, research-based interventions to improve student outcomes.
RTI provides interventions often within a General Education setting.
RTI includes Universal Screening.
RTI Universal Screening identifies all students at risk early.
RTI has a Multi-Tiered System.
RTI Tier 1 is high-quality, differentiated classroom instruction for all students.
RTI Tier 2 is targeted, small-group interventions for students not making sufficient progress.
RTI Tier 3 is intensive, individualized interventions or specialized instruction.
RTI includes Progress Monitoring.
RTI Progress Monitoring continuously tracks student data to measure growth and adjust instruction.
RTI includes Data-Based Decision Making.
RTI Data-Based Decision Making uses data to determine if a student needs higher-level support or specialized evaluation.
RTI is a general education initiative designed for all students.
RTI is not itself a special education program.
RTI can be used to identify students needing special education evaluations.
The goal of RTI is to provide immediate support to prevent long-term failure and bridge learning gaps.
RTI International is a non-profit research institute.
Real-Time Innovations (RTI) is a software framework company for autonomous systems.
Respiratory Tract Infection (RTI) is an infectious disease.
